paragraphs.source_en: The mistress inside the paper screens began singing while playing the two-stringed koto. Miss Calico said proudly, “What a lovely voice!” “It does sound lovely, but I do not quite understand it. What is she singing, exactly?” “You mean what she is singing? I hear it is called something-or-other. The mistress is very fond of that tune. My mistress is already sixty-two this year, and how sturdy she is.” If one is alive at sixty-two, one must certainly be called sturdy. I could only reply, “Indeed.” The answer sounded rather foolish, but there was nothing for it; no cleverer reply came to mind at the moment. Miss Calico went on, “They say she was once of very good standing. She is always saying so herself.” “What was she originally, then?” “Apparently she is the daughter of the nephew of the mother-in-law of the younger sister of Tenshoin’s secretary.” “What did you say?” “It is that sister of Tenshoin’s secretary, who married into another family...” “Ah, I see! No, wait a moment, the secretary of Tenshoin’s younger sister...” “Oh no, that is not it; it is the younger sister of Tenshoin’s secretary...” “Good, now I have it. It is Tenshoin’s...” “Exactly!” “The secretary’s...” “Yes, that is right!” “Married into...” “No, the younger sister married into...” “Yes, yes, I was mistaken; the younger sister married into her husband’s family...” “The daughter of the mother-in-law’s nephew!” “Oh, the daughter of the mother-in-law’s nephew.” “Yes. You understand now, don’t you?” “No, it is all too tangled; I cannot make head or tail of it. To put it simply, what relation is she to Tenshoin?” “You really are terribly slow. Haven’t I been telling you? She is the daughter of the nephew of the mother-in-law of the younger sister of Tenshoin’s secretary.” “That much I understood long ago, but...” “If you understand that, isn’t that enough? What more are you asking?” “Yes, I suppose so.” Having no choice, I admitted defeat. At times we are forced to tell lies that must somehow be made to sound logically airtight.

paragraphs.source_zh: 那位师傅在纸窗里边唱边弹起了二弦琴。三毛姑娘得意地说：“多好听的声音呀！”“是很好听，不过，我不太懂，到底唱的是什么？”“你说她唱的？听说就是那个什么呀。师傅可喜欢这个曲子啦。我家师傅今年已经六十二岁了，身体多结实呀。”六十二岁还活着，当然应该说是结实。我只好回答一声：“嘿。”虽然这样回答有点傻乎乎的，但没办法，一时想不出其他更妙的回答。三毛姑娘接着说道：“听说她过去出身很不错，平时她总是这么说。”“她原来到底是干什么的？”“据说她是天璋院的秘书的妹妹的婆母的侄子的女儿。”“你说什么呀？”“就是那个天璋院秘书的妹妹嫁到婆家去的……”“原来是这样啊！不，请等一等，天璋院的妹妹的秘书的……”“哟，不是的，是天璋院的秘书的妹妹……”“好，这回明白啦，是天璋院的……”“对啦！”“秘书的……”“就是呀！”“嫁到了……”“不是，是妹妹嫁到……”“对，对，是我弄错了，是妹妹嫁到婆家去的……”“婆婆的侄儿的女儿！”“噢，是婆婆的侄儿的女儿呀。”“是呀，这回明白了吧。”“不，这太乱了，很难理出个头绪来，简便点说，是天璋院的什么人？”“你也未免太笨啦，我刚才不是说了吗，她是天璋院的秘书的妹妹的婆婆的侄儿的女儿嘛。”“这点我倒是早就清楚了，不过……”“你清楚不就行了吗？还问什么？”“是啊。”我无可奈何只好认输。我们有时候不得不说些无理也要说出三分理的谎话来。
